title: 8-bit ripple-carry adder
prompt: Design an 8-bit adder with carry-in and carry-out. Inputs a and b are 8-bit unsigned vectors, cin is a single bit. Output sum is 8 bits and cout is the carry out.
functional_requirements: sum = a + b + cin (mod 256) | cout is the 9th bit of the sum

title: 8-bit ALU (ADD/SUB/AND/OR/XOR)
prompt: Design an 8-bit ALU with a 3-bit opcode selecting ADD(000), SUB(001), AND(010), OR(011), XOR(100). Inputs a and b are 8-bit. Outputs result (8-bit) and a zero flag.
functional_requirements: opcode selects the operation | zero=1 iff result is 0

title: 8-bit magnitude comparator
prompt: Design an 8-bit unsigned comparator with outputs gt, eq, lt.
functional_requirements: exactly one of gt/eq/lt is high

title: 8x8 unsigned multiplier
prompt: Design an 8x8 unsigned combinational multiplier. Inputs a and b are 8-bit; output product is 16-bit.

title: I2C bit-level controller (start/stop/byte)
prompt: Design an I2C master byte controller that generates START and STOP conditions and shifts out 8 bits MSB-first on sda synchronised to scl, asserting done after the byte and sampling the ack bit.
functional_requirements: generates START and STOP | 8-bit MSB-first shift | samples ack

title: SPI master (mode 0)
prompt: Design an SPI master in mode 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0) shifting 8 bits MSB-first. On start, generate sclk, drive mosi, sample miso, and assert done when complete.
functional_requirements: MSB-first 8-bit transfer | mode 0 timing | done pulses on completion

title: UART transmitter (8N1)
prompt: Design a UART transmitter for 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit. A start pulse latches data and shifts it out LSB-first framed by a start (0) and stop (1) bit. tx_busy is high during transmission. Assume a one-clock-per-bit baud tick.
functional_requirements: frames data with start=0 and stop=1 | LSB-first | tx_busy asserted during frame

title: Switch debouncer
prompt: Design a switch debouncer that only propagates the input to the output after it has been stable for N=8 consecutive clock cycles.
functional_requirements: output changes only after 8 stable cycles

title: PWM generator (8-bit duty)
prompt: Design an 8-bit PWM generator. A free-running 8-bit counter compares against an input duty value; pwm_out is high while counter < duty. Synchronous reset.
functional_requirements: duty cycle proportional to duty input

title: 4-tap FIR filter
prompt: Design a 4-tap FIR filter with fixed coefficients [1,2,2,1] over signed 8-bit samples. On each clock, shift in a new sample and output the convolution sum.

title: Moving-average filter (window 4)
prompt: Design a moving-average filter over the last 4 unsigned 8-bit samples, outputting the average (sum divided by 4).

title: Sequence detector (1011, overlapping)
prompt: Design an overlapping Mealy/Moore sequence detector that asserts found for one cycle when the serial input bit stream contains 1011. Synchronous active-high reset.
functional_requirements: asserts found on 1011 | overlapping matches supported

title: Traffic-light controller FSM
prompt: Design a traffic-light FSM with states RED, GREEN, YELLOW cycling on each clock tick enable. Synchronous active-high reset returns to RED. Output lights is a 3-bit one-hot (RED=100, GREEN=010, YELLOW=001).
functional_requirements: cycles RED->GREEN->YELLOW->RED on tick | reset forces RED

title: Synchronous FIFO (depth 16)
prompt: Design a synchronous FIFO, 8-bit wide, depth 16, with wr_en/rd_en, full and empty flags, and synchronous active-high reset.
functional_requirements: FIFO ordering preserved | full/empty flags correct | no overflow/underflow

title: 32x32 register file (2R1W)
prompt: Design a 32-entry, 32-bit register file with two read ports and one write port. Register 0 always reads as zero. Writes are synchronous.
functional_requirements: reg 0 reads zero | two independent read ports | synchronous write

title: Synchronous single-port RAM (256x8)
prompt: Design a synchronous single-port RAM, 256 words x 8 bits, with a registered read output and a write-enable.

title: ALU control decoder
prompt: Design an ALU control unit: given a 2-bit ALUOp and a 4-bit funct field, output a 4-bit ALU control signal following the classic MIPS mapping (add/sub/and/or/slt).
functional_requirements: decodes ALUOp+funct to control | defaults defined for all inputs

title: 2-bit saturating branch predictor
prompt: Design a 2-bit saturating counter branch predictor. On each resolved branch (taken input), update the state; predict output is high when in a 'taken' state. Synchronous active-high reset to weakly-not-taken.
functional_requirements: saturates at strongly taken/not-taken | predict = MSB of counter
